display.purpose: Rare section introductions and empty states.

shadows.name: pdf-sheet
shadows.purpose: Separates document paper from desk ground.

shadows.name: transient-ui
shadows.purpose: Selection popup and context menu only.

motion.name: duration-standard
motion.purpose: Pane and transient UI state changes.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Replace non-essential transitions when reduced motion is requested.

focus.rule: Use :focus-visible; never remove focus without an equivalent visible treatment.

breakpoints.name: minimum-window
breakpoints.behavior: Keep canvas and primary reader controls reachable; collapse right pane, then left pane.

breakpoints.name: dual-pane-comfort
breakpoints.behavior: Below this width, do not open both side panes automatically.

breakpoints.name: wide-workspace
breakpoints.behavior: Both side panes may remain open while preserving a comfortable page canvas.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single highest-priority action in a local region.

components.name: Search Field
components.description: Search with an explicit label and honest indexing coverage.

components.name: Navigation Rail Item
components.description: A full-width destination with visible active structure.
components.html: Reader
components.css: .ds-rail{width:66px;background:#eae9e9;border-right:2px solid rgba(32,30,29,.4)}.ds-rail a{min-height:55px;display:grid;place-items:center;padding:8px 2px;border-left:3px solid transparent;color:#605d5d;text-decoration:none;font:800 10px/1.2 Archivo,Arial,sans-serif}.ds-rail a[aria-current=page]{border-left-color:#ec3013;background:#f3f2f2;color:#201e1d}.ds-rail a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #ec3013;outline-offset:-2px}

components.name: Pane Tabs
components.description: Ruled tabs for switching a pane without card-like containers.
components.css: .ds-tabs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(32,30,29,.4);background:#eae9e9}.ds-tabs button{min-height:36px;border:0;border-right:1px solid rgba(32,30,29,.4);border-bottom:2px solid transparent;border-radius:0;background:transparent;color:#605d5d;font:800 11px/1.2 Archivo,Arial,sans-serif;text-transform:uppercase}.ds-tabs button[aria-selected=true]{border-bottom-color:#ec3013;background:#f3f2f2;color:#ae1800}.ds-tabs button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #ec3013;outline-offset:-2px}

components.name: Annotation Filter
components.description: Semantic filter that pairs its swatch with a label and selected mark.

components.name: Annotation Row
components.description: A flat evidence row with source, category, and page identity.
components.html:
Evidencep. 18
Retrieval precedes source reveal.

User comment stays distinct from the quote.
components.css: .ds-annotation{padding:12px;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(32,30,29,.4);border-left:3px solid #8fb583;background:#eae9e9;color:#201e1d;font:400 14px/1.55 Archivo,Arial,sans-serif}.ds-annotation header{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;color:#605d5d;font-size:11px}.ds-annotation header strong{color:#201e1d}.ds-annotation blockquote{margin:8px 0;padding-left:8px;border-left:2px solid rgba(32,30,29,.4)}.ds-annotation p{margin:8px 0 0}

components.name: Selection Popup
components.description: Transient annotation actions bound to a captured selection snapshot.
components.css: .ds-selection{display:flex;border:1px solid rgba(32,30,29,.55);background:#eae9e9;box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(45,43,43,.20)}.ds-selection button{min-height:36px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:6px 10px;border:0;border-right:1px solid rgba(32,30,29,.4);border-radius:0;background:transparent;color:#201e1d;font:800 11px/1.2 Archivo,Arial,sans-serif}.ds-selection button:hover{background:#d7d3d3}.ds-selection button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #ec3013;outline-offset:-2px}.ds-selection span{width:10px;height:10px;background:#d9bd3a;border:1px solid #201e1d}

components.name: Context Menu
components.description: Keyboard-safe alternate route to the same captured-selection actions.

components.name: Dialog
components.description: A square modal surface with explicit title and ordered actions.
components.html:
Remove annotation?

The annotation moves to recoverable deleted state.
components.css: .ds-dialog{width:min(440px,calc(100vw - 32px));padding:16px;border:1px solid rgba(32,30,29,.55);border-top:2px solid #ec3013;border-radius:0;background:#eae9e9;color:#201e1d;box-shadow:0 12px 32px rgba(45,43,43,.22);font:400 14px/1.55 Archivo,Arial,sans-serif}.ds-dialog h2{margin:0 0 12px;font-size:20px}.ds-dialog footer{display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;gap:8px;margin-top:16px}.ds-dialog button{min-height:36px;padding:8px 12px;border:1px solid rgba(32,30,29,.4);border-radius:0;background:#f3f2f2}.ds-dialog .primary{background:#ec3013;color:#f3f2f2;border-color:#ec3013}.ds-dialog button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #ec3013;outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Review Rating Group
components.description: Calm, source-hidden retrieval ratings with tabular interval previews.
components.css: .ds-ratings{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);padding:0;border:1px solid rgba(32,30,29,.4);background:#eae9e9}.ds-ratings legend{grid-column:1/-1;padding:0 0 8px;font:800 11px/1.2 Archivo,Arial,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.08em}.ds-ratings button{min-height:48px;border:0;border-right:1px solid rgba(32,30,29,.4);border-radius:0;background:transparent;color:#201e1d;font:800 11px/1.2 Archivo,Arial,sans-serif}.ds-ratings button:last-child{border-right:0}.ds-ratings button:hover{background:#d7d3d3}.ds-ratings button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #ec3013;outline-offset:-2px}.ds-ratings small{display:block;color:#605d5d;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}

narrative.overview: Mereth is a focused Modernist work surface where documents, provenance, and the reader's thought outrank decorative chrome. Architectural rules, square geometry, a warm neutral ground, and one red accent provide a restrained hierarchy. Zotero informs interaction quality but not Mereth's visual language or citation scope.

rules.name: The One Red Voice Rule
rules.body: Signal Red is the only interface accent; semantic annotation colors do not decorate navigation.

rules.name: The Reading Voice Rule
rules.body: Heavy type establishes structure while regular type carries thought.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Persistent surfaces use rules and tonal layers; shadows are reserved for paper, transient UI, and dialogs.

dos: Pair annotation color with semantic labels.
Keep core controls reachable at 1024 by 640.
Honor reduced motion and visible focus.
donts: Do not add gradients or ornamental effects.
Do not introduce rounded cards or pill filters.
Do not imitate Zotero's visual language.
Do not present post-v1 features as disabled v1 promises.
